fields.v: No (0): independent of the agent and model vendors (Codex CLI, GPT, Claude judge), but every skill condition evaluated (personalized, other-developer, generic, ablations) is produced by the authors' own skill-generation framework; the only other condition is the no-skill baseline, which is not an external approach
fields.quote: We consider four conditions: (A) no skill, (B) the target developer’s personalized skill, (C) a personalized skill from another random developer and (D) a generic skill pooled across all developers.
fields.why: The protocol gives Partly when the authors' approach is compared with external ones; here all skill conditions come from the authors' framework and the comparator is no skill, so No is equally defensible.
fields.doubt: Todas as condições com skill (B, C, D, E, F) saem do framework dos próprios autores; a única alternativa é 'sem skill', que não é uma abordagem externa. A regra dá Parcial só quando há abordagens externas comparadas. Vê a pág. 5 e decide entre Não (0) e Parcial (0,5).
